text:
Sofia: hey team, first morning and ran into a weird flow. did the macOS update during setup and when FileVault prompt came up I picked "Use my iCloud account" (personal Apple ID). Kandji now shows "escrow failed - unsupported recovery type" and the onboarding checklist is blocked. anyone know how to fix without wiping?
leo-it: welcome Sofia! yep that's a known edge-case. corporate policy disallows iCloud-based FileVault recovery because we can't escrow that key. did you already complete Kandji enrollment or did you click the invite after you enabled FileVault?
Sofia: I clicked the Kandji invite after the update completed. Kandji shows device enrolled but FileVault escrow is missing.
kandji-bot: Kandji last check-in: 2026-02-10T08:42:01Z. Device state: Enrolled. FileVault escrow: Unsupported (iCloud personal recovery used). Pending actions: recommend-remove-personal-recovery.

leo-it: can you paste the output of `sudo fdesetup status`?
Sofia: pasted below:
```bash
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Users: Sofia (Enabled)
Escrow: Personal iCloud recovery in use (non-institutional)
```
Sofia: also in System Settings -> FileVault the toggle is on but the UI shows "Recovery: iCloud account (personal)" and the "Turn Off FileVault" button is greyed out.
leo-it: that greyed out button means the protector is managed by iCloud and requires the user to sign out of iCloud or remove that recovery option. we have two safe routes: 1) IT temporary admin session to remove the personal iCloud protector and let Kandji push institutional escrow (fast); 2) full wipe/reprovision with MDM-first image (cleaner but longer). which do you prefer?
Sofia: prefer avoid wipe. route 1 ok if it's safe.
alex-sec: security side endorses route 1 only if we log the action and verify escrow immediately. iCloud-backed recovery is not acceptable for company assets. confirm you don't need anything tied to your personal Apple ID on this device (Photos, Keychain items).
marta-people: looping HR for tracking. Sofia i'll add a note to your onboarding ticket. :white_check_mark:
Sofia: i don't have personal photos on it, and i already backed up a few keychain items to my personal cloud. ok to proceed.
deploy-bot: temp-admin session created for leo-it (30m). ticket #ONB-5302.
leo-it: opening the session now. plan: 1) have you sign out of iCloud (we'll guide), 2) remove the personal recovery protector, 3) force Kandji to push institutional escrow, 4) verify with `sudo fdesetup status`. i'll DM you during the changes.
Sofia: signed out of iCloud, down to login screen. ready when you are.
leo-it: removed the personal iCloud recovery protector and pushed Kandji escrow. verify status:```bash
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Users: Sofia (Enabled)
Escrow: Institutional recovery key present (Kandji)
```
Sofia: confirmed after restart - unlocked with my account password and Kandji shows escrow present. :tada:
alex-sec: great. please re-register any second-factor tokens in the SSO console and confirm MDM check-ins over the next 24h. we've logged the operation per compliance.
marta-people: onboarding ticket updated and will be closed once you confirm SSO MFA re-registration.
Sofia: re-registered MFA and everything's green. huge thanks, leo. coffee on me when I'm in the office. :coffee:
leo-it: happy to help! we'll add a note to the new-hire doc: "If you plan to use a personal Apple ID, enroll MDM first or choose company recovery during FileVault setup."
